## Appearance

Agatha Sowerby is a stout woman weighing two hundred pounds, whose heavy body causes her gait to be a perpetual waddle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P30](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is a kind, compassionate, and industrious woman who thoroughly enjoys dressmaking and being consulted for guidance. A pious church member, she firmly disbelieves in higher education for women and takes pride in voicing her opinions candidly and without partiality. Though meddlesome, boastful of her raspberry cordial, and lacking in delicacy, she acts as a tireless and forbearing caregiver. She maintains durable views, harbors a strong prejudice against [Yankees](../codex/factions.md#yankee), and carries a pessimistic belief that pleasant anticipations end in disappointment. Furthermore, she is a passionate partisan who frequently feels burdened by every concern of church and state.

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby resides on St. Brendan's [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island), having raised ten children and lost two [F1, F4, F6]. Learning that [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) intended to adopt an orphan from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to work at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she visited [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to express strong doubts and warnings about the decision [S1, S2]. During a subsequent visit, she mocked the orphan Nell's plain appearance and red hair, causing the girl to fly into a rage [S3]. After [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) persuaded [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to apologize, Mrs. Sowerby graciously accepted her dramatic apology at her own home and offered her words of encouragement [S4]. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later smashed a slate over Hugh Carrow's head, Mrs. Sowerby advised [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to let the girl rest at home until her temper subsided [S7]. She later assisted [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) by selecting fabric and sewing a stylish gown with puffed sleeves for Nell's [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift [S13]. Over time, she praised Nell's growth and grace [S16], and she celebrated alongside the family when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tied for first place on the island in her entrance examinations [S18, S19]. ## Quotes

> "However, I had a bit of a scare that you might not be, seeing Obed head out earlier today. My thought was that perhaps he was heading to the doctor’s office."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "I simply reckon she has succeeded, and I would certainly not hold back from stating as much. You bring honor to your companions, Nell, indeed you do, and every one of us is proud of you."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "I’m not aware of it. My assumption is that your teaching will take place directly here in Brierley. You have been selected by the trustees to receive the school."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

> "While I was returning from Delford today, Mr. Pettifer was seen by me driving your Jersey from his oats. It appeared to me that he was quite furious. Was a big fuss made by him?"
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "She’s awfully thin and plain, Thirza. Step over this way, child, so I can inspect you. Goodness gracious, has anyone ever witnessed such freckles? And hair that is as red as carrots! Step over this way, child, I tell you."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

Agatha initially established a hostile relationship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) after rudely mocking her appearance and red hair, which provoked [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) into a violent temper. However, the conflict ended after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visited Agatha's house to deliver a dramatic apology, which Agatha accepted while offering her encouragement. Agatha later served as an advisor to Nell's guardian, recommending that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) be allowed to rest at home to let her temper cool after an incident at school.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thirza-abernethy.md)

Agatha and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) share a longstanding friendship as neighbors. Agatha frequently visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to exchange news, offer warnings, and provide advice on raising children, while also accompanying [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) as a traveling companion on a boat trip into town. Following the death of Agatha's husband, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes having the widowed Agatha move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).
